objectives.title: General Right to Object Implementation
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding data subject objections to processing based on public-interest/official-authority or legitimate-interest grounds, including related profiling.
criteria: Mechanisms enabling data subjects to submit objections based on particular situations.
Processes halting processing upon receipt of an objection.
Procedures evaluating compelling legitimate grounds overriding data subject interests.
Procedures assessing processing necessary for legal claims defense.
Provisions confirming the objection right extends to profiling carried out under those processing grounds.

objectives.title: Direct Marketing Objection Handling
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding objections to direct marketing activities.
criteria: Mechanisms recording data subject objections to direct marketing.
Terms prohibiting personal data processing for direct marketing following an objection.
Terms prohibiting direct marketing profiling following an objection.

objectives.title: Presentation of Objection Rights
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding notification procedures for objection rights.
criteria: Provisions explicitly presenting the right to object at initial communication.
Provisions presenting the right to object separately from unrelated information.
Specifications requiring clear formatting for objection notices.

objectives.title: Automated Objection Procedures
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding technical mechanisms for exercising objections.
criteria: Technical specifications enabling data subjects to exercise the right to object by automated means within information society services.
System capabilities recognizing and honoring automated objection signals as valid objections.

objectives.title: Research Processing Objections
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding objections to research data processing.
criteria: Mechanisms handling objections to scientific research processing.
Mechanisms handling objections to statistical processing.
Verification procedures establishing public interest processing exemptions.
